requirement.shall: Every planned SkillCapsule exposes XNL apiVersion/version identity and exactly one canonical provenance manifest that binds source identity, generator protocol and all payload file digests.

case.given: the same SkillCapsule authority, payload bytes and different resource enumeration order
case.when: the distribution planner builds the capsule
case.then: provenance bytes, file digests, capsule digest and closure digest are byte-identical

case.given: source FQN, apiVersion, version or a payload byte changes
case.then: the corresponding provenance and enclosing digests change

case.given: a plan has missing, duplicate, malformed or mismatched provenance facts with otherwise recomputed outer digests
case.then: it returns stable SKILL_PLAN_PROVENANCE_INVALID before any target mutation

requirement.shall: Halfcode compiles sys-halfcode-resource-dsl from canonical Resource DSL resources into a versioned, progressively loadable and host-neutral consumer SkillCapsule.

case.given: the canonical Resource DSL ResourcePackage and sys-halfcode-resource-dsl root
case.then: references contain the registered canonical docs, examples and readable provenance without a second maintained body

case.when: a consumer selects a Resource DSL task
case.then: the file routes progressive reference loading and contains no repository maintenance command or host operation
XNL is the sole authority for name sys-halfcode-resource-dsl, apiVersion and version 1.0.0, while YAML contains no duplicate identity field

requirement.shall: The consumer Skill and provenance extension preserve legacy compiler calls, ten public specifiers and the Halfcode/Eidolon authority boundary.

case.when: they import root and skill-capsule entrypoints
case.then: existing calls remain valid and new provenance types/runtime are additive

case.given: the Resource DSL package and compiled Skill
case.then: there is no Eidolon path, global/workspace policy, installer or domain routing rule

case.when: the public registry and repository residues are inspected
case.then: 0.2.2 remains unpublished and no tarball, staging or backup residue exists
